scope: LQ-F CE-level stages: the native logged source (native logged accept and handler, annotated-to-native correspondence, the log growing exactly as the Server session counter does), the LQ-F later game of the common deployment experiment (post-run reveal of every created Beacon's Ed25519 identity seed and X25519 prekey and one-time scalars, the Server Ed25519 identity seed and every generated Server ephemeral scalar), CE-COMPILE for that game to the logged source with its budget transport, and the per-target KEM transfer of CE-9 (steps 9.1-9.4) carried to it with bills and the exact-sum headline, for confidentiality only. Profile (owner decision, plan section 27): every honest X25519 secret and every honest Ed25519 identity secret, except two kinds of scalar that are never published or used: (a) the one-time scalars of failed Beacon bundle attempts (generated at beaconcrypt/src/beacon.rs:302, dropped when signing or serializing the bundle fails at beacon.rs:349-357, public key never output) and (b) the Server ephemeral of an accept that fails the PQ-key parse (generated at beaconcrypt/src/server.rs:368, dropped when the parse rejects at server.rs:369-372, before encapsulation, any DH step or any publication). Both are documented with this reason and get no further proof work; with LQ-F they replace deviation D6 of LQ. The LQ-F reveal leaves out (a) (in no state) and also contains (b), because the log records every generated ephemeral; no statement relies on that. DH outputs are derived, not listed; ML-KEM secrets are never revealed. Item 2 and the headlines are open.
